newsitem.title: USA: KTI Inc buys recycling firm.
newsitem.headline: KTI Inc buys recycling firm.

text.p: KTI Inc said on Monday it acquired I. Zaitlin & Sons, a recycling company based in Biddeford, Maine.
The purchase price was $500,000 in cash, 200,000 shares of KTI stock and the assumption of $2.3 million of Zaitlin debt, KTI said in a statement.
Zaitlin operates processing, brokering and storage facilities in Maine and Massachusetts, KTI said. The acquisition also includes Data Destruction Services Inc, a records destruction firm.
